catalysts.headline: Elastic reported Q2 FY2027 results (quarter ended 2026-10-31): revenue $496M (+17% YoY, beat ~$487M consensus); non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.94 (beat $0.81 consensus); non-GAAP operating income $110M (22.2% margin); board approved a new $500M buyback authorization ($55M repurchased in Q2). Guided Q3 FY2027 revenue to $507.5M-$508.5M and non-GAAP EPS to $0.90-$0.92, both below Street estimates, citing an incremental ~$4.5M FX headwind; raised full-year FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance to $3.35-$3.41.
catalysts.impact: Shares fell ~8% in regular trading ahead of the print and another ~8% after-hours on the weak Q3 guide, despite the Q2 beat
